regulations.notes: Nassau County STR regulations vary by town. No uniform county-wide rules exist — each town/village sets its own requirements. NY State STR law S.885C/A.4130C (signed Dec 2024) will create a statewide registration requirement. Occupancy taxes range 3-5% depending on the town.
